pipeline: PROVIDER → MODEL → CAPABILITY → ACCOUNT → QUOTA → ROUTER
selection_rule: deterministic lexical sort: provider_id ASC, account_id ASC, model_id ASC; prefer_* filters applied after sort when supplied
unknown_policy: capacity/quota/rate_limit status === 'unknown' → candidate not selectable (unknown ≠ available)
rules: does not execute models or call providers
no complex scoring or fallback engine
unknown capacity/quota never coerced to available
